task:
UI redesign phase 4 — Inspect tabs and the evidence pop-out (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md` §4 row P4 and "Phase 4 — Inspect tabs"; the plan is on PR #1001 and will be on main shortly — if it is not yet, read it from branch `codex/run-41535815581-1`). apps/web only. No backend, route or contract change.

WHAT TO BUILD:
1. Organise Inspect (`apps/web/src/routes/inspect/+page.svelte`, `lib/components/SystemDetail.svelte`, `SystemRatings.svelte`, `SourcesFreshness.svelte`) into three main-task TABS — **Overview** (system facts, the seven economy potentials from SystemRatings, Sources & freshness trigger), **Bodies** (the 3D System Map with its legend/unplaced lists and the body list/selected-body card), **Stations** (ports and their economies). Use a labelled `role="tablist"` with roving focus, Arrow/Home/End navigation, `aria-controls`/`aria-labelledby`, and hidden panels that cannot keep keyboard focus. Switching tabs must NOT refetch (the existing TanStack queries stay mounted/cached) and must NOT discard the selected body, the open Sources pop-out state or scroll positions; the chosen tab is reflected in the URL as a bounded `tab=` parameter (default Overview, invalid values ignored) so links and reloads restore it. Keep the existing `data-*` hooks used by Cypress (search the product journey and `tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` for Inspect selectors and keep them valid; update the journey where a tab must be opened first).
2. Move the SystemRatings inline "Why?" explanations into an **evidence pop-out** (non-modal, closable, Escape, focus returns to the Why button; reuse the Sources & freshness pop-out pattern/component structure) that shows the existing explanation content for one economy at a time; keep the seven independent potentials and their tiers exactly as today — no new aggregate score, no inferred evidence, no freshness timestamp, no build-eligibility badge. Unknown / Not integrated yet / Temporarily unavailable wording stays as is.
3. Styling: use the design-kit tokens from PR #998 (`--panel`, `--panel-raised`, `--line`, `--accent`, `--neon`, `--text-muted`, `--radius`, `--font-hud`) with the existing values as fallbacks (`var(--x, <fallback>)`) because #998 may merge before or after this PR; tabs follow the kit's `[role='tablist']`/`[role='tab']` skin; do not restyle unrelated components.
4. Tests: Vitest for tab navigation/keyboard/aria, no refetch on switch (assert query call counts), selection retention across tabs, URL `tab=` round-trip, evidence pop-out open/close/focus/content and axe (the repo uses axe-core in component tests); extend the product-journey Inspect section (open each tab, open/close evidence, keyboard, axe, reduced motion) and keep the contract pins green; Review Lab's injected partial/failed detail scenarios must still render without fabricating values.
5. `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`; CHANGES.md entry at the top ("UI redesign P4: Inspect tabs and evidence pop-out"); update the plan doc's P4 row to "implemented in this PR". Visual change: needs Product E2E/visual validation before promotion; not deployed.
